title: If Brains are Computers, Who Designs the Software? - with Daniel Dennett
summary: Daniel Dennett's Royal Institution lecture on whether the brain is a computer and where its software comes from. He argues that minds are built by evolution and culture, with competence arising without comprehension.
why: Cited as an excellent entry point to Dennett's thinking on minds, memes and competence without comprehension.

quote.text: I discovered him with the excellent Royal Institution talk
